title: Reviewed budget history
responsibility: Combines repeated ledger events into review histories and selects the reviewed limits relevant to a unit’s source and emitted targets.

inputs.name: budgetReviews.ledgers
inputs.description: One list of budget ledger lines per revision, in ledger order; a line that appears more than once is kept once, because events are compared by canonicalJson (object keys sorted, undefined object fields dropped). Nothing is validated here, so every line must already match BudgetEvent.

examples.reason: Limits frozen when the unit was first established.

Source grew with the approval table export; the complexity rise was reviewed.
First verified record of the evidence grid report.

inputs.name: frozenLimits.baseline
inputs.description: The reviewed BudgetBaseline of one unit in one revision, or undefined when that revision has none, which makes frozenLimits return undefined. Only its metrics and unmeasured fields are read, so its performance entries are ignored.

unmeasured.source-bytes: Not measured: src/parser/grammar.ts was not read.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.unit
inputs.description: The unit's ComponentManifest, of which only the kind of each runtime.targets entry is read, and only the wasm and process kinds count because those are the targets built as a file of their own. A unit with no wasm or process target emits nothing, which makes emittedLimits return undefined.

examples.title: Budget report command
examples.responsibility: Prints the budget findings of one verified record as plain text.

examples.title: Emitted sizes
examples.responsibility: Selects the frozen emitted size of each execution target from a unit's measurements.

inputs.name: emittedLimits.baseline
inputs.description: The reviewed BudgetBaseline of the same unit in one revision, read for the artifact-bytes:<kind> metric and the unmeasured reason of each wasm or process kind. When it is undefined, a unit that emits still gets an empty limits map, because no limit was reviewed.

unmeasured.artifact-bytes:process: dist/bin/budget-report was not built in the verified snapshot.

outputs.name: budgetReviews
outputs.description: Maps each unit id to its reviews, with duplicate events removed and each list sorted ascending by its at string; a unit with no events is absent. Each review holds the type, the commit and record id of the measured record, the reviewer, reason and at, the after limits, the before limits for an approval only, and unmeasured when the event has one.

outputs.name: frozenLimits
outputs.description: The source-bytes, complexity and dependencies limits that the baseline holds, under metrics, with their unmeasured reasons under unmeasured when there are any; other metrics, including the artifact-bytes limits, are left out. The result is undefined only when the baseline is undefined, and metrics is {} when the baseline holds none of the three.

unmeasured.source-bytes: Not measured: src/parser/grammar.ts was not read.

outputs.name: emittedLimits
outputs.description: Under limits it holds, keyed by kind, the reviewed limit of each distinct wasm or process kind among the unit's targets that the baseline holds an artifact-bytes:<kind> metric for; an unmeasured reason for such a kind goes under unmeasured when the baseline recorded one. It is undefined when the unit has no wasm or process target, and limits is {} when none of those kinds has a reviewed limit.
